sourceIdentity.confirmedAgainst: STATE_MANIFEST.csv canonical_relative_path + sha256, then the binary itself
sourceIdentity.fieldCountDiscrepancyNote: The manifest counts widget annotations; pdf-lib counts terminal fields, and a field with several widgets is one field. The observed number is what this package binds against.

explicitMappings.note: Petition to expunge. Six-row charge table indexed from one. This form ships text fields with no /DA entry; D0 supplies a neutral default before any value is written, which governs how a value is drawn and never what it is.

determinism.basis: the canonical fixture rendered twice from the same source bytes and the same facts

sourceDrift.basis: one byte of the source flipped, then finalized against the pinned sha256

classifierAgreement.rule: A binding needs both keys: the typed fail-closed binder and the independent nine-class classifier. Where they disagree the field is withheld unless a recorded override says why it is safe.

withheldByLaneReview.reason: A city box in the defendant's address block. `\baddress\b` matches before `\bcity\b`, so the binder offers the whole street address for a city field. Withheld.
A state box in the defendant's address block, mis-bound to the street address for the same reason as Def.Address.City.

A zip box in the defendant's address block. The descriptor list matches \baddress\b before \bzip\b, so the binder offers the street address. The right fact exists but the binder cannot be told to use it without editing the shared descriptor list, so the field is left blank.
A jail identification number, reached through the same 'Def' token. Never populated.

A social security number box. The binder reached it through the 'Def' token in the field path and would have written the petitioner's NAME into it. Withheld outright; an SSN is never populated by this factory.
